name: Fixed15 RankIC diversification buffer risk: weekly versus fortnightly versus calendar month end
bootstrap: All start from the same 2012-01-06 signal, executing next session close; no different first-entry timing
weekly: Original completed W-FRI weeks, last open session; partial final week excluded
fortnightly: Every second calendar W-FRI week anchored on bootstrap week; empty holiday weeks do not reset phase
monthly: Last open session of completed calendar months plus common bootstrap; no partial final month
factor_weights: Reuse identical sealed monthly252 matured5day RankIC weights for every arm; as-of latest update <= signal; no new factors or ICIR
portfolio: Same fixed15, top100 candidates, industry20%, specified theme35%, pair correlation0.8 and retained top30 buffer as parent
risk: Unchanged DAILY intended-basket volatility budget and thresholds; risk-only trades can happen between scheduled reselections and reset equal target proportions, not necessarily proportional actual positions
cost_attribution: Every execution classified BOOTSTRAP, SCHEDULED_ONLY, SCHEDULED_AND_RISK, RISK_ONLY or HOLD. Joint-day costs not artificially split into unidentifiable causal contributions
universe_benchmark: Keep parent's weekly costed common-pool equal-weight benchmark unchanged across strategy frequency comparisons
index_policy: Request total return and price indices; require complete common-date data. If TR unavailable, report price-only limitation, do not synthesize dividends or silently shorten comparison
index_entry: Index level frozen at common first execution close; NAV=1 on initial signal date; no ETF fees, buy-and-hold index benchmark
limitations: Observed historical data, not untouched OOS or automatic deployment
Same inherited adjusted-price fractional-share engine, not lots/actual commissions/taxes/limits/capacity
PIT availability uses existing supplier financial snapshot and industry intervals; original vintages not fully recoverable
Scheduled universe eligibility checked only at reselection as in parent; not new daily forced-risk exits
Changing frequency also changes holding horizons, score freshness and calendar timing; no universal optimal-frequency claim
Fixed15 stock-capital distribution, exposure changes and index style differences prevent interpreting raw return gaps as pure alpha
Missing quotes block execution and keep stale marks; retain stranded-position sensitivity
